lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a semi-regular grid with larger, more spaced centroids in the mid-lateral region and smaller, more densely packed clusters extending toward the cranial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized lattice-like pattern across the visible mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a distinct light-to-shadow gradient transition along their horizontal axes.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of smaller teleost fish (remoras) visible beneath the ventral-lateral surface and pectoral fin; pectoral fin displays a high-contrast spotting pattern on its dorsal surface.
